features.name: Highland Park Entry Garden
features.description: Highland Park Entry Garden is the formal Highland Avenue arrival, centered on the fountain, gardens, reflecting pools and landmark stone columns at the foot of the climb toward Reservoir Drive.

features.name: Highland Park Reservoir Loop
features.description: Highland Park Reservoir Loop is the paved walking and running circuit around Reservoir No. 1 above the formal garden, with broad water views and connections to the park's upper recreation areas.

features.name: Pittsburgh Zoo and Aquarium
features.description: Pittsburgh Zoo & Aquarium is Highland Park's separately operated, ticketed zoo and aquarium campus, with its own Baker Street entrance, free parking, seasonal admission schedule, food, restrooms and accessibility services.
